Led the quarterly research planning session with the product design team, deciding the research calendar and recording the decisions in the planning notes.
Coordinated research logistics with compliance and the business units, recording that the business units owned participant availability while I owned scheduling, consent and the plan sign-off.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, plan sign-off, participant recruitment, consent records and the quarterly planning session over about two years.
